{{Top|leg}}
A '''Voice amplifier''' was a device that could be used to amplify someone's voice, so that they could be heard clearly from up to half a kilometer away. [[Vril Vrakth]], a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], owned one and used it to speak to a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents during the [[Battle of Nizon]].<ref name="The First to Strike">{{DoD|The First to Strike}}</ref>
